apps.name: BrewLog
apps.subtitle: Pour-over brewing companion
apps.localizedDescription: Live BOOKOO scale guidance, a brew journal and taste-based tips for your next cup.

versions.localizedDescription:
• The recipe card moves to the bottom of the Brew screen
• Smoother pour curve, and the brew's water is where the scale settled, not a spike
• An espresso machine's gear page shows its connection instead of a pour-over method
• Timemore Black Mirror Dot checked against Timemore's open protocol, Basic3 Link recognized
• Espresso machines get their own gear section and are connected in the setup assistant

• La Marzocco request signing
• Read La Marzocco's machine dashboard
• La Marzocco machines through your La Marzocco account
• La Marzocco connection stays open, never revives after sign-out and follows the chosen machine

• Read GaggiMate's profile list with the selected profile
• Choose the GaggiMate profile from the espresso screen and brew with it
• Decode the Decent DE1's shot samples and states
• Decent DE1 over Bluetooth with live shot data, following and controlling shots
• DE1 disconnects always end the shot, profile sheet survives a dropped machine
• Imported yields keep their decimals, your recipe edits survive picking a profile again

• The mode switch no longer resets or hitches when the screen behind it changes
The Filter | Espresso switch sat inside the .id(mode) subtree, so every switch
rebuilt it with empty widths and the thumb grew in from zero. It now lives
outside, segments are equally wide (laid out in one pass, no preference
round trip), taps no longer jump the thumb to the finger first, and quick
taps back and forth cancel the pending swap instead of swapping twice.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01641JjvwhhHSdTbVTqCXwLC

• Import GaggiMate profiles as espresso recipes
From a profile file exported from GaggiMate's web interface (Import) or
straight from the connected machine (Settings > Espresso machine). Phases
map to pre-infusion, yield, pressure and are kept as tips.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01641JjvwhhHSdTbVTqCXwLC

• With GaggiMate the pressure comes from the machine, no pressure sensor offered
The BOOKOO pressure sensor is only for machines BrewLog can't connect to
(or a GaggiMate without a pressure sensor). With GaggiMate the sensor row is
hidden in Settings and on the machine card, the device strip shows the
machine's pressure, and the shot records the machine's readings even if a
sensor is still paired.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01641JjvwhhHSdTbVTqCXwLC
• The mode switch's thumb slides (tap or drag) before the screen changes

• Compact Filter | Espresso and Journal | Stats switch in the top bar, the Brew title no longer slides under it

• Espresso lists only espresso machines, filter only pour-over brewers

• Remove leftover of the old mode picker

• ShotMonitor decides when an espresso shot stops and finishes

• Espresso remembers its own setup

• Espresso shots stop at the target yield and finish by themselves

• Live shot readouts with ratio, flow, pressure and temperature

• Filter | Espresso switch with its own espresso screen

• Espresso auto-stop settings

• BrewStats computes activity, trends, beans and recipes

• Brews feed the statistics

• Statistics for pour-over and espresso with charts and trends

• Keep the yield ping without auto stop and own espresso recipes in the espresso setup

• Release notes say what changed, not "Merge pull request"
scripts/release-notes.sh builds the notes from the commits a merge brings
in (or the commit itself), without merge lines, Co-Authored-By trailers or
"feat(ios):" prefixes. Used for the SideStore source, the iOS release and the
Android release; the workflows now check out enough history for it.

Merge pull request #10 from proelio57/fix/widget-circle

Roomier circular Lock Screen widgets

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your Bluetooth coffee scale to read the weight live while you brew.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: BrewLog uses the camera to photograph your coffee bag and read the details from its label. The photo stays on this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your espresso machine (GaggiMate) in your Wi-Fi to record pressure and temperature and to start shots.
